messages:
Maria (CS): Hey team — ParcelPro opened an escalation. Since yesterday's rollout they see intermittent schema validation failures from their strict parser. Example payload attached below.
ParcelPro (Customer): Here's a failing response we got from the API (copied verbatim):
{
  "status": "ok",
  "items": ["sku_1", "sku_2",],
  "priority": "HIGH"
}
ParcelPro (Customer): Parser error reported: "Unexpected token ',' at position ..." and their validator also rejects "HIGH" because their schema expects enum ["low","medium","high"] (lowercase).
Maria (CS): Request id for one example: rp-20260315-9932. Model reported in headers: redwood-open-7b-v2-flip. Canary was 50% last night.
Luca (SRE): Thanks. Can you confirm time window and % of failures?
ParcelPro (Customer): About 6 failures out of ~20 calls between 18:15–19:05 UTC on 2026-03-15. Not constant but reproducible with similar prompts.
DeployBot: Deployment event: release-2026-03-15 applied to canary (50%) at 2026-03-15T18:02:00Z.
Ashok (ML Eng): Interesting — trailing comma in array and uppercase enum. We don't normally produce trailing commas in canonical JSON. Two hypotheses: (1) a pretty-print path accidentally appends a comma when serializing short lists, (2) a postprocess normalization step uppercased enums on a codepath.
Tim (Oncall): If this is customer-impacting >5%, we should consider rollback for affected customers. Current failure rate for ParcelPro namespace is ~30% for that window.
Maria (CS): ParcelPro asked for ETA and workaround. They prefer a fix, but will accept being pinned to previous model for now.
Luca (SRE): Can we pin ParcelPro to redwood-open-7b-v1-stable immediately? Need Product sign-off for customer routing.
Beth (Product): Approved. We can pin them while eng investigates.
Ashok (ML Eng): Repro steps I used locally:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-open-7b-v2-flip","prompt":"Generate order items as JSON","max_tokens":160,"temperature":0.0}'
2) Observe pretty-printed output path (postprocess=pretty) occasionally emits a trailing comma when list length >1. Also observed that enum normalizer has a branch that forces uppercase for some tokens.
Ashok (ML Eng): Created internal repro and added unit test. Patch: disable pretty-print for structured outputs by default and normalize enums to lowercase. PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/4821 (fix/disable-pretty-structured-serialize).
Luca (SRE): Good. Can we release a hotfix to canary ASAP and route ParcelPro to previous model meanwhile?
Tim (Oncall): I'll prepare rollback playbook if hotfix doesn't stabilize canary. Monitoring alert created: namespace.parser_failure_rate > 1% -> pager.
Maria (CS): Sent ParcelPro the pin instructions and offered temporary workaround: set tolerant parser or request model pin. Ticket created: CS-42189.
Ashok (ML Eng): Patch merged to main. Hotfix build scheduled deploy for 2026-03-16T03:00:00Z (release-2026-03-16-hotfix). Added end-to-end tests to catch trailing commas and enum casing.
ParcelPro (Customer): Pinning to v1_stable fixed our immediate issue, thanks. Please confirm when hotfix lands so we can unpin.
Maria (CS): Confirmed — we'll notify when hotfix is live and follow up to verify sample responses. Closing loop after post-deploy verification.
Beth (Product): Internal issue tracked ENG-8702. Prioritizing extra fuzz tests for structured outputs.
Tim (Oncall): I'll keep watch on the alert and abort rollout if failures spike.
Maria (CS): Thanks everyone — great triage. ParcelPro appreciated the quick pin. :pray: :tada:
